title: hawkes-engine: multivariate Hawkes processes with trust calibration
description:
Multivariate Hawkes processes with exponential kernels for Python: a compiled likelihood and gradient, a maximum-likelihood fit with standard errors, two independent exact simulators, time-rescaling diagnostics, and a lookup of what a pre-registered simulation study measured about the fit's standard errors in a given regime.

The calibration map comes from a pre-registered study of 128 simulation cells with 2000 replications each, frozen before the data existed at the tag H6-preregistration with six dated amendments. Its principal finding is a limitation: pooled over the two-type cells with at least 2000 events, the standard errors the fit reports are 0.779 (95% interval 0.757 to 0.801) times the empirical standard deviation of its estimates, and 0.61 for the decay block. Two of the six pre-registered hypotheses were not confirmed, and the estimator is undefined where the observation window holds only a fraction of one decay time. The library reports what was measured and where nothing was.
notes: 0.1.0 was deposited manually; the first automatic deposit for a later release may need to be queued in the Zenodo web UI. The preregistration is at the annotated tag H6-preregistration.
